description: This file implements a validation service for flow validation, including checking node connectivity, input parameters, nested configurations, credentials, and edge consistency within a flow data structure.

classes.name: IValidationResult
classes.description: Interface defining the structure of validation results, including node id, label, name, and issues.

methods.name: checkFlowValidation
methods.description: Asynchronous function that validates a flow by checking node connectivity, input parameters, nested configs, credentials, and edges, returning a list of validation issues.
